lastResponse.text: Yes, I hear you. This is an emergency. Call nine one one now for your friend. If they’re hard to wake, breathing slow, or passed out, tell nine one one that right away. Keep them on their side, don’t give more alcohol or pills, and stay with them until help arrives.
originalTexts: Yes, I hear you. This is an emergency. Call 911 now for your friend. If they’re hard to wake, breathing slow, or passed out, tell 911 that right away. Keep them on their side, don’t give more alcohol or pills, and stay with them until help arrives.
